turns.message: We'd like to start with €4.5 per unit for 94 units.
We can move to a higher price per unit €5.2 but, at that price we would order 93. We really need the quantity to be above 90 at this price point.
Come on we are on the same team. Let's keep the quantity above 90, we suggest 91 units at €6.1 per unit.
We're prepared to go down to 87 units only if we keep the price at a maximum of €7.1 per unit.
How about 74 units, we can't go any higher than €7.8 p.u. as I have another supplier's paperwork already on my desk with similar terms.
We value your excellence, as such we are able to stretch it to an absolute max of €8 p.u. for a min of 66, consider this a personal favor.
We are far beyond my signing authority, I just consulted with higher management and we need to order more than 60 units. As such, we will order 61 units at 8.2€ p.u.
Last offer, take it or leave it, we order a quantity of 61 at a price per unit of €8.50, the board wants a signature today.
